description: This file defines the FromTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, which handles parsing 'from' import statements in Twig templates, allowing macro imports from other templates.

classes.name: FromTokenParser
classes.description: Final class in the Twig namespace responsible for parsing the 'from' import syntax in Twig templates, enabling macro imports from specified templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'from' import statement in Twig, extracting macro to import and handling aliases, then constructs an ImportNode for rendering.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'from' which this parser handles.
